chapterInfo.content:
8
Nyankopɔn asɛm ho nkɔm
1Sei na AWURADE Nyankopɔn maa mehunuiɛ, na hwɛ, nnuaba a abereɛ wɔ kɛntɛn mu. 2#Amos 7.8 Na ɔbisaa sɛ: Amos, ɛdeɛn na wohunu yi? Na mese: Nnuaba a abereɛ kɛntɛn. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ:
Awieeɛ no aduru ama me man Israel,
merenkɔ so mensiane wɔn mu bio.
3 # Amos 6.10 Na asɔrefie nnwom bɛdane adwotwa ɛda no,
AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie,
afunu no bɛdɔɔso,
na wɔde kommyɛ bɛtoto wɔn agu mmaa nyinaa.
4 # Amos 2.7 Montie yei, mo a moregye ahiafoɔ amene
sɛ moresɛe asase so amanehunufoɔ,
5 # Neh 10.32; 13.15 na mobisa sɛ: Da bɛn na bosome foforɔ bɛtwam
na yɛatɔn ayuo,
ne homeda,
na yɛabue ɛsan ano,
na yɛayɛ efa ketewa, na yɛama n’abrammoɔ ayɛ kɛseɛ,
na yɛakyea nsania de asisie?
6 # Amos 2.6 Na yɛama dwetɛ de atɔ mmɔborɔni,
na yɛde mpaboa atɔ ohiani,
na yɛatɔn ayuo ase deɛ ɛguguo no.
7AWURADE aka Yakob ahokyerɛ ntam sɛ:
Me werɛ remfiri wɔn nneyɛɛ nyinaa da biara da!
8 # Amos 9.5 Yei nti asase renwoso
na ɛsofoɔ nyinaa renni abooboo anaa?
Na asase mu nyinaa bɛpuhu sɛ Asubɔnten Nil,
na wɔbɛfono no na atwe sɛ Misraim asuo no.
9 # Yer 15.9 Na ɛda no, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie,
mɛma owia atɔ awiaberɛ,
na mɛma sum aduru asase so awia ketee.
10 # Yer 6.26 Na madanedane mo nnapɔnna mu abooboo
ne mo nnwom nyinaa kwadwom,
na mama ayitoma akyekyere asene nyinaa,
na atipa aba atire nyinaa so;
na mama no ayɛ sɛ ɔba korɔ ho abooboodie,
na n’awieeɛ ayɛ sɛ da a ɛyɛ nwono.
11Hwɛ, nna bi reba, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie,
sɛ mɛma ɛkɔm aba asase no soɔ,
ɛnyɛ aduanekɔm anaa sukɔm,
na AWURADE asɛm tie deɛ.
12 # Mika 3.7 Na wɔbɛkyini afiri po ano akɔ po ano,
na wɔawɔ ntwɛtwɛdɛ
afiri atifi fam akɔsi apueeɛ fam, sɛ wɔrehwehwɛ AWURADE asɛm akyiri kwan,
na wɔrenhunu.
13Ɛda no, sukɔm nti
mmabaa a wɔn ho yɛ fɛ ne mmeranteɛ bɛtotɔ piti,
14wɔn a wɔkeka Samaria asodie ntam,
na wɔse: Sɛ wo, Dan, wo nyame te aseɛ yi!
ne: Sɛ Beer-seba kwan te aseɛ yi!
no, wɔn deɛ, wɔbɛtotɔ na wɔrensɔre bio.

Sei na AWURADE Nyankopɔn maa mehunuiɛ, na hwɛ, nnuaba a abereɛ wɔ kɛntɛn mu. Na ɔbisaa sɛ: Amos, ɛdeɛn na wohunu yi? Na mese: Nnuaba a abereɛ kɛntɛn. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ:
Awieeɛ no aduru ama me man Israel,
merenkɔ so mensiane wɔn mu bio.
Na asɔrefie nnwom bɛdane adwotwa ɛda no,
AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie,
afunu no bɛdɔɔso,
na wɔde kommyɛ bɛtoto wɔn agu mmaa nyinaa.

Montie yei, mo a moregye ahiafoɔ amene
sɛ moresɛe asase so amanehunufoɔ,
na mobisa sɛ: Da bɛn na bosome foforɔ bɛtwam
na yɛatɔn ayuo,
ne homeda,
na yɛabue ɛsan ano,
na yɛayɛ efa ketewa, na yɛama n’abrammoɔ ayɛ kɛseɛ,
na yɛakyea nsania de asisie?
Na yɛama dwetɛ de atɔ mmɔborɔni,
na yɛde mpaboa atɔ ohiani,
na yɛatɔn ayuo ase deɛ ɛguguo no.

AWURADE aka Yakob ahokyerɛ ntam sɛ:
Me werɛ remfiri wɔn nneyɛɛ nyinaa da biara da!
Yei nti asase renwoso
na ɛsofoɔ nyinaa renni abooboo anaa?
Na asase mu nyinaa bɛpuhu sɛ Asubɔnten Nil,
na wɔbɛfono no na atwe sɛ Misraim asuo no.

Na ɛda no, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie,
mɛma owia atɔ awiaberɛ,
na mɛma sum aduru asase so awia ketee.
Na madanedane mo nnapɔnna mu abooboo
ne mo nnwom nyinaa kwadwom,
na mama ayitoma akyekyere asene nyinaa,
na atipa aba atire nyinaa so;
na mama no ayɛ sɛ ɔba korɔ ho abooboodie,
na n’awieeɛ ayɛ sɛ da a ɛyɛ nwono.

Hwɛ, nna bi reba, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie,
sɛ mɛma ɛkɔm aba asase no soɔ,
ɛnyɛ aduanekɔm anaa sukɔm,
na AWURADE asɛm tie deɛ.
Na wɔbɛkyini afiri po ano akɔ po ano,
na wɔawɔ ntwɛtwɛdɛ
afiri atifi fam akɔsi apueeɛ fam, sɛ wɔrehwehwɛ AWURADE asɛm akyiri kwan,
na wɔrenhunu.

Ɛda no, sukɔm nti
mmabaa a wɔn ho yɛ fɛ ne mmeranteɛ bɛtotɔ piti,
wɔn a wɔkeka Samaria asodie ntam,
na wɔse: Sɛ wo, Dan, wo nyame te aseɛ yi!
ne: Sɛ Beer-seba kwan te aseɛ yi!
no, wɔn deɛ, wɔbɛtotɔ na wɔrensɔre bio.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
